scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dspv2/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @dspv2/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @dspv2/frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @dspv2/shared lint && pnpm --filter @dspv2/backend lint && pnpm --filter @dspv2/frontend lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @dspv2/shared format && pnpm --filter @dspv2/backend format && pnpm --filter @dspv2/frontend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @dspv2/shared format:check && pnpm --filter @dspv2/backend format:check && pnpm --filter @dspv2/frontend format:check
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm cloudflare:build && pnpm dlx wrangler@latest pages deploy apps/front-end/dist --project-name dispatchpilot-web --config wrangler.pages.jsonc
